slides.texte_overlay:
things the BEST student in class
never says

"i'll ask about it later"
she asks right after class, while it's still fresh.

"i'll just read it over"
she solves one exercise first. reading comes after.

"i studied, i swear"
she tests herself without notes, so she KNOWS she studied.

"the teacher never explained that"
she checks the textbook before saying it wasn't covered.

"i'll put my phone away in a minute"
it's already in her bag. that minute never comes.

"i don't need to write it down, i'll remember"
every due date goes in one list, the day she hears it.
